## Layer A — Finding

The clinical description completed for all 99 frozen census cases, with field-dependent usable observations rather than complete clinical coverage [cite: summary.json | root | status, analyzed_cases]. The primary disability median contrast was +1.5, but its rank-biserial contrast was 0.07072368421052631 with an omission-sensitivity range crossing sign, so no clinical-separation verdict follows [cite: clinical_estimation_table.csv | construct=mrs_3month,item=contrast_diff_medians | contrast_value] [cite: clinical_estimation_table.csv | construct=mrs_3month,item=contrast_rank_biserial | contrast_value, note]. Admission severity and sex had small observed contrasts, whereas later severity and age had insufficient head coverage and the contextual fields yielded no usable contrasts [cite: clinical_estimation_table.csv | construct=nihss_admission,item=contrast_smd_pooled | contrast_value] [cite: clinical_estimation_table.csv | construct=sex,item=contrast_diff_prop_F | contrast_value] [cite: summary.json | census | nihss_24h, age, mtici_postinterventional, onset_to_door]. The earlier arithmetic remains a head absolute-contribution share of 0.5063509495830807 beside an eligible-support share of 0.08961200117675944 [cite: summary.json | support_constants_of_record | head_abs_contribution_share, head_support_share]. These are exploratory descriptions with confidence limited to the recorded arithmetic: selected membership, missingness and noninferential sensitivity displays prevent conclusions about clinical silence or other patients.

**Demonstrates:** successful registered descriptive completion and the tabulated arithmetic for usable observations. **Suggests:** clinical description is sensitive to the chosen summary and incomplete coverage; no coherent mechanistic or subgroup explanation follows. **Does not establish:** clinical absence, equivalence, causality, a clinical subtype, prediction performance or generalization. The support context is a joint display, not covariate adjustment, and its medians are full-group quantities rather than variable-complete-case medians.

**Uncertainty:** points and omission ranges are deterministic; the only randomness is the hypothetical reference, with seed 20260902 and 10000 relabelings [cite: clinical_uncertainty.json | root | seed, n_relabelings, draw_rule]. Later-NIHSS SMD has only 9987 defined reference draws [cite: clinical_uncertainty.json | constructs.nihss_24h.contrasts.smd_pooled.relabeling | n_defined]. Neither that reference nor omission sensitivity is sampling uncertainty or a bound on missing outcomes. Additional training seeds are not the relevant remedy. No CONFIRMED claim or null-exclusion statement is made.

**Positive/negative findings and validity:** completion is the positive procedural result; there is no registered directional negative. Unavailable contextual contrasts and parse failures are evidence limitations, not negative associations. No new invalidating failure is identified from the accepted source-bound evidence. The original console supports correspondence and saved completion, not an independently attested exit code. Cell suppression does not prevent reconstruction from margins; this private interpretation does not decode suppressed cells or authorize export.
